features:
• System Server IPC Hooking: Can thiệp PhoneSubInfo & ITelephony Binder.
• One UI Native Overrides: Hook SecDeviceNameController & Settings Provider.
• Safe Zygote & RIL Recovery: Nạp lại Zygote & Modem Daemon, bảo vệ Baseband.
• Zero-Touch Spoofer Core: Tự động đồng bộ APK v2.4.2 qua OTA.
• Kernel Network Rescue: Khởi tạo Virtual TUN (/dev/net/tun) & xả kẹt Iptables.
